newsitem.title: USA: National Media sees Q4 operating loss.
newsitem.headline: National Media sees Q4 operating loss.

text.p: National Media Corp said it expects to report an operating loss for its fourth quarter ended March 31, and that it is reviewing its operations.
"The loss is due to its business improving more slowly than expected in the fourth fiscal quarter," the company said in a prepared statement on Monday.

It said it is evaluating some of its corporate acquisitions, the carrying value and amortization of production costs, the value of inventories and receivables and a restructuring of operations, as well as other matters.
"As a result, the company expects to incur additional losses due to these potential adjustments," National Media said.

The company also said it retained Lehman Bros as a financial advisor, in addition to JP Morgan, after heavy trading in its stock in late February and early March suggested "outside interest in the company."
"We decided at that time that we needed an additional independent perspective in order to best serve the interest of our shareholders," said Frederick Hammer, chairman of National Media.
